remarks: Own a piece of history with the Quintard-Frost House, a stunning antique Dutch Colonial home built in 1715 that seamlessly blends historic charm with modern comfort. This 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom residence showcases timeless craftsmanship, including original wide-plank floors, exposed beams, and period details throughout. At the heart of the home is a true antique bar with fireplace, a rare and inviting space perfect for entertaining. The grand dining room sets the stage for unforgettable family gatherings, while the sunroom and eat-in kitchen offer warm and inviting spaces for everyday living. Step outside to enjoy the beautiful patio, an ideal spot for relaxing or hosting under the open sky. A 2-car garage provides convenience, completing this exceptional offering. Situated within walking distance to the train as well as the Corbin District, this home offers easy access to restaurants, coffee shops, and shopping, blending historic charm with the best of modern-day convenience. Steeped in history yet designed for modern living, the Quintard-Frost House is a rare opportunity to own a historic treasure in a prime location. Don't miss your chance to make this timeless property home!
